_doc: The living Ashen's camp kit (ADR-0048, the Ashen highcamp): a war drum, a spear rack, clay pots of lichen-ash, a drying rack and a fed camp fire. Models: tools/assetgen/blender/generators/props_ashen_camp.py -> models/props/<id>[_worn].glb (catalog tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/props_outskirts.py); materials game/data/materials/props_ashen_camp.json (plus the watch camp's out_* materials). size = [width x, height y, depth z] in metres (Godot axes, front +Z); before the models exist each prop draws as a box of its size. The camp fire burns where a POI places it with "lit": true (PropLights: light, flames, crackle; its embers glow only then); worn is a fire burning low.

defs.name: War Drum
defs.description: A log drum with a rawhide head laced on with sinew, tilted in a cradle of crossed poles under a deer skull hung with bone charms. The Ashen beat it to call the camp.

defs.name: Spear Rack
defs.description: Spears with knapped flint and bone heads leaning on a lashed crossbar between two forked posts, a hide quiver of throwing sticks on one post.

defs.name: Ash Pots
defs.description: Coil-built clay pots of grey-green lichen-ash by a grinding stone, a big jar with a hide tied over its mouth. The ash hides the Ashen's scent from the Hollowed.

defs.name: Drying Rack
defs.description: Strips of venison drying on sinew under a ridge pole between two A-frames, a scraped hide over the rail and another stretched on a sapling hoop.

defs.name: Camp Fire
defs.description: A ring of river stones round a deep bed of coals, split logs stood in a cone over it, a spit on forked sticks and a clay pot in the ashes. Somebody feeds it.
